title: DATESQTD is the first day of the quarter to the selected date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATESQTD ( 'Date'[Date] ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2023, 8, 15 ) )

source.quote: Returns a set of dates in the quarter up to the last date visible in the filter context.
source.supports: DATESQTD goes from the first day of the quarter to the last visible date

derivation: August 15, 2023 is in the third quarter, which starts July 1: 31 + 15 = 46 days. Sales: Jul 1 70 (the year to date would be 280).
